module.purpose: Provides the React Flow pane container that handles pane interactions, selection rectangles, auto-panning, click behavior, pointer capture, and propagation of pane-level callbacks.
module.summary: This module implements the interactive canvas surface for React Flow. It coordinates Zustand state with DOM pointer and mouse events, distinguishes pane interactions from child-node interactions, manages selection rectangles and connected edge selection, supports configurable drag selection and panning, and forwards pane callbacks while suppressing conflicting click or connection events.
module.businessContext: Supports node-based diagram editing and interaction. If it fails, users cannot reliably select, pan, click, or complete pane interactions in the editor.
functions: wrapHandler (~L52-61): Restricts delegated mouse handlers to events targeting the pane container
Pane (~L71-373): Coordinates pane rendering, selection, pointer handling, panning, and callbacks
commitUserSelectionRect (~L180-251): Updates selection geometry and synchronizes selected nodes and edges
autoPan (~L253-267): Repeatedly pans the viewport while selection approaches container edges
cleanupAutoPan (~L269-273): Cancels the active animation frame and resets auto-pan state
onPointerMove (~L279-307): Starts, advances, and commits a drag selection
onPointerUp (~L309-344): Finalizes selection, pane clicks, pointer capture, and callbacks
onPointerCancel (~L346-349): Releases pointer capture and stops automatic panning

process: Schedules and cancels browser animation frames for auto-panning.

detail.name: wrapHandler
detail.signature: wrapHandler(handler: MouseEventHandler | undefined, containerRef: MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>): MouseEventHandler
preconditions: containerRef is a mutable ref object whose current value may be an HTMLDivElement or null.
postconditions: Returns a MouseEventHandler.
The returned handler invokes the supplied handler only when event.target === containerRef.current.
invariants: Events whose target is not exactly containerRef.current are not forwarded.
An undefined supplied handler is safely ignored.
edgeCases: If handler is undefined, the returned handler performs no callback invocation when the target matches.
If containerRef.current is null, no event with a non-null target is forwarded.
If event.target is a descendant or another element rather than the exact current container element, the supplied handler is not invoked.
detail.summary: Creates a mouse-event handler that forwards events to the supplied handler only when the event target is exactly the current container element.

detail.name: Pane
detail.signature: export function Pane({ isSelecting, selectionKeyPressed, selectionMode = SelectionMode.Full, panOnDrag, autoPanOnSelection, paneClickDistance, selectionOnDrag, onSelectionStart, onSelectionEnd, onPaneClick, onPaneContextMenu, onPaneScroll, onPaneMouseEnter, onPaneMouseMove, onPaneMouseLeave, children }: PaneProps)
preconditions: The component receives a PaneProps-compatible object.
Selection operations that depend on a store require the store's DOM node, transform, and selection state to be available.
postconditions: Returns a pane div containing the supplied children and configured pointer, click, context-menu, wheel, and mouse handlers.
When a selection completes, the store's user selection state is cleared and node selection activation reflects whether nodes were selected.
Auto-pan animation is cancelled when the component unmounts or pointer interaction is cancelled or completed.
invariants: Selection rectangles are represented with non-negative width and height and preserve the renderer-space selection start position.
Only selectable nodes inside the current selection rectangle are selected.
Selectable edges connected to selected nodes are included in the selection.
Non-primary, non-left-button, no-key, or otherwise inactive pointer-down events do not start a selection.
Click handling is suppressed after an in-progress selection or when a connection ended on the pane.
edgeCases: If the store has no DOM node bounds at pointer-down time, the event does not initialize a selection.
If a pointer move occurs without container bounds or a user selection rectangle, it is ignored.
Pointer movement at or below paneClickDistance does not begin selection unless the selection key is pressed.
A pointer-up with a non-left button is ignored.
If selection is disabled and a connection is in progress on the pane, pointer-up records that the connection ended on the pane instead of selecting.
When auto-panning is disabled or container bounds are unavailable, auto-pan does not start.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Invalid or inapplicable pointer events are ignored or have their propagation/default behavior conditionally suppressed; no explicit exception path is defined.

stateMutations: Mutates the component's refs for container bounds, selected node and edge IDs, pointer position, selection progress, connection completion, and auto-pan state.
Updates store userSelectionRect, userSelectionActive, nodesSelectionActive, and selected node and edge changes.
Invokes store resetSelectedElements when a selection begins after exceeding the configured movement threshold.
Starts and cancels requestAnimationFrame-based auto-pan state.
eventsEmitted: Invokes onSelectionStart for a selection that exceeds the movement threshold.
Invokes onSelectionEnd when an active selection ends.
Invokes onPaneClick for an eligible pane click.
Invokes onPaneContextMenu, onPaneScroll, onPaneMouseEnter, onPaneMouseMove, and onPaneMouseLeave for their corresponding pane events when configured.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Renders a React div with class react-flow__pane, configured event handlers, ref={container}, style={containerStyle}, and children. Selection rectangles use startX, startY, x, y, width, and height numeric fields.
detail.summary: Renders the pane that coordinates pointer interaction, pane callbacks, selection rectangles, edge and node selection, and optional auto-panning. It prevents conflicting click or selection behavior while preserving the configured pane and selection semantics.

units.name: commitUserSelectionRect

detail.name: commitUserSelectionRect
detail.signature: function commitUserSelectionRect(mouseX: number, mouseY: number): void
preconditions: mouseX and mouseY are screen-coordinate pointer positions.
The store and selection state dependencies are available.
postconditions: When a user selection rectangle exists, the store contains a rectangle derived from the transformed selection start and the supplied pointer coordinates.
Selected node and edge sets reflect the current selection rectangle.
The store has userSelectionActive set to true and nodesSelectionActive set to false.
Node and edge changes are triggered only when their corresponding selected-ID sets change.
invariants: The selection rectangle startX and startY remain the original user selection start coordinates.
The rectangle x and y are the minimum screen coordinates of the start and current pointer positions.
The rectangle width and height are non-negative absolute distances.
Only selectable connected edges of selected nodes are included in the selected edge set.
edgeCases: If userSelectionRect is absent, the function returns without changing selection sets or store state.
If the pointer is above or left of the transformed selection start, the rectangle origin moves to the pointer while width and height remain absolute distances.
If the pointer does not change the selected node or edge sets, the corresponding change trigger is not called.
When defaultEdgeOptions.selectable is absent, edges are treated as selectable unless an individual edge explicitly sets selectable to false.
Edges connected to selected nodes are included only when the edge exists and is selectable.
stateMutations: selectedNodeIds.current is replaced with the node IDs inside the computed selection rectangle.
selectedEdgeIds.current is replaced with selectable edge IDs connected to the selected nodes.
The store userSelectionRect is replaced with the computed rectangle.
The store userSelectionActive is set to true.
The store nodesSelectionActive is set to false.
eventsEmitted: Node selection changes are published through triggerNodeChanges when node selection changes.
Edge selection changes are published through triggerEdgeChanges when edge selection changes.
detail.summary: Updates the active user-selection rectangle from pointer coordinates and synchronizes selected nodes and connected selectable edges with the store. If no user selection is active, the function performs no action.

specTests.when: commitUserSelectionRect is called with any numeric mouse coordinates.
specTests.then: It returns without changing selection sets or store state.

specTests.when: commitUserSelectionRect is called with pointer coordinates.
specTests.then: It computes a non-negative screen-coordinate rectangle, selects nodes inside it, selects only selectable edges connected to those nodes, and stores the rectangle with userSelectionActive true and nodesSelectionActive false.

specTests.when: commitUserSelectionRect is called.
specTests.then: Neither triggerNodeChanges nor triggerEdgeChanges is invoked, although the selection rectangle state is updated.

units.name: autoPan

detail.name: autoPan
preconditions: autoPanOnSelection must be truthy and containerBounds.current must be available for auto-panning to proceed.
panBy must return a promise resolving to whether panning occurred.
postconditions: When auto-panning is enabled and container bounds exist, another autoPan invocation is scheduled with requestAnimationFrame.
If the selection is in progress and panBy reports that panning occurred, commitUserSelectionRect is invoked with the current pointer coordinates before the next frame is scheduled.
invariants: The next animation frame is scheduled after panBy resolves, regardless of whether selection remains active or panning occurred.
The selection rectangle is committed only when selectionInProgress.current is truthy and panBy resolves to a truthy value.
edgeCases: When autoPanOnSelection is falsy, the function returns immediately without calculating movement, invoking panBy, or scheduling a frame.
When containerBounds.current is absent, the function returns immediately without calculating movement, invoking panBy, or scheduling a frame.
When panBy resolves to a falsy value or selectionInProgress.current is falsy, no selection rectangle is committed, but another animation frame is scheduled.
stateMutations: Updates autoPanId.current with the identifier returned by requestAnimationFrame.
May indirectly update selection state through commitUserSelectionRect when active selection panning succeeds.
detail.summary: Continues selection auto-panning by calculating movement from the current pointer position and container bounds, then schedules another animation-frame iteration. When panning occurs during an active selection, it commits the updated selection rectangle.

specTests.when: autoPan is called.
specTests.then: No selection rectangle is committed, and requestAnimationFrame schedules another autoPan iteration.

specTests.when: autoPan is called and the panBy promise resolves.
specTests.then: commitUserSelectionRect is called with the current position coordinates, and requestAnimationFrame schedules another autoPan iteration.

detail.name: cleanupAutoPan
postconditions: The animation frame identified by the current auto-pan ID is cancelled.

stateMutations: autoPanId.current is set to 0.
autoPanStarted.current is set to false.
detail.summary: Cancels any scheduled auto-pan animation and resets the auto-pan scheduling and started-state markers.

specLiterals.role: Sentinel value indicating that no auto-pan animation frame is currently tracked.

preconditions: The store may provide a DOM node and renderer transform.
Selection state and container references are available from the enclosing Pane.
postconditions: If the container bounds are available and the event satisfies all selection conditions, selectionInProgress.current is set to false.
For an accepted event, store state contains a zero-sized userSelectionRect whose start coordinates are derived from the event position transformed into renderer coordinates.
For an accepted event, pointer capture is requested on the event target when supported.
For an accepted event targeting a non-container element, event propagation is stopped.
For a rejected event or unavailable container bounds, no selection rectangle is initialized.
invariants: Only primary left-button pointer events can initiate selection.
A target inside an element matching the .nokey selector cannot initiate selection.
Selection initiation requires isSelecting and either an active drag-selection on the container or selectionKeyPressed.
The selection rectangle starts with width and height equal to zero.
edgeCases: If the store has no DOM node or getBoundingClientRect produces no bounds, the handler returns without changing selection state.
If the event target is a descendant matching .nokey, the handler returns without starting selection.
If the event is not a left-button primary event, selection is not started.
If selection is disabled or no valid selection activation condition is present, the handler returns without starting selection.
If the accepted event target is not the container, propagation is stopped after initializing the selection.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns without starting selection when the container bounds are unavailable or the event fails any selection eligibility condition.

selectionInProgress.current is set to false for accepted selection-start events.

detail.summary: Handles pointer-down events during selection by validating the event context, capturing the pointer when appropriate, and initializing the user selection rectangle in renderer coordinates.

Left-button pointer events are the only button events accepted for selection initiation.

specTests.when: The handler receives the pointer-down event.

detail.name: onPointerUp
preconditions: The event argument is a React pointer event.
The handler has access to the pane container ref, store, selection refs, and optional callbacks through its enclosing Pane component.
